title: Publication-Ready Artifact Packaging
description: AIL 606 textbook section connecting publication-ready artifact packaging to storyboard frame sequence with narration, signaling, and reader-action notes, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.

learning_objectives.statement: Identify the reuse test: could a competent stranger find the canonical artifact and reproduce its use from the package alone?
Build a package with a README (intent and decision log), a single dated canonical file, per-asset provenance, an explicit license, and a changelog
Record asset provenance (source and license) rather than silently reusing images
Decide what to include and what to summarize (e.g., disclose AI assistance in the README rather than dumping a full chat log)

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
